Name: Inline Search Field (Table)
Description: Small magnifier input confined to a data‑table header.

Name: Load‑More Button
Description: Manual button to append additional results—alternative to infinite scroll.

Name: Result Count Badge
Description: Text like “98 results” updating live as filters change.

Name: Tag Filter Chips (Multi‑Select)
Description: Row of chips that toggle active state, visible above results.

Name: Sort‑By Dropdown
Description: Menu offering “Relevance”, “Newest”, “Price ↑/↓”.

Name: Search Results List (Row)
Description: Vertical list of results with title, snippet, and metadata.

Name: Voice Search Button
Description: Microphone icon triggering speech‑to‑text query input.

Name: Recent Searches List
Description: Dropdown section showing the last few queries for quick reuse.

Name: Autosuggest Dropdown
Description: List of best‑match items appearing as users type, with keyboard navigation.

Name: Toggle Switch Filter
Description: On/off switch such as “Free Shipping” or “Open Now.”

Name: Advanced Search Link
Description: Text link opening a modal with additional field‑specific filters.

Name: Saved Search Button
Description: Star icon saving the query and filters for later one‑click access.

Name: Filter Drawer (Mobile)
Description: Off‑canvas panel opened by “Filters” button, optimized for phone screens.

Name: Did‑You‑Mean Tooltip
Description: Inline suggestion under search bar offering alternate spelling.

Name: No‑Results Illustration
Description: Friendly image plus suggestions (“Check spelling, try fewer filters”).

Name: Query Builder UI
Description: Visual tool letting users add rows of field / condition / value without typing SQL.

Name: Pagination Bar
Description: Page numbers with next/prev arrows below results.

Name: Search Results Grid (Card)
Description: Masonry or equal‑height cards showing images and titles.

Name: Search‑Within‑Results Input
Description: Secondary search bar that narrows current result set only.

Name: Search Operator Cheatsheet Popover
Description: “?” icon listing boolean operators (AND, OR, ”exact”).

Name: Saved Search List Modal
Description: Popup showing all saved searches with edit and delete icons.

Name: Popular Searches Chips
Description: Clickable pill buttons under the bar suggesting trending queries.

Name: Bulk Filter Apply Button
Description: Instead of auto‑apply, a primary button applies selected filters at once.

Name: Color Swatch Filter
Description: Row of colored circles usable for apparel or design assets.

Name: Fuzzy Match Slider
Description: Slider adjusting similarity threshold from strict to loose matching.

Name: Radio Button Filter
Description: Single‑choice list—for mutually exclusive options like “In stock only.”

Name: Active Filters Bar
Description: Horizontal list of currently applied filters as chips with “×” remove icons.

Name: Star‑Rating Filter Row
Description: Five stars row; clicking filters to that rating and above.

Name: Checkbox List Filter
Description: Scrollable list where multiple values (e.g., brands) can be checked.

Name: Recommendation Block (“Related Searches”)
Description: Carousel of suggested queries at bottom of results page.

Name: Real‑Time Result Preview
Description: Dropdown pane under the bar showing live matched items before hitting Enter.

Name: Clear All Filters Link
Description: One‑click action resetting all facets to default.

Name: Faceted Filter Sidebar
Description: Stacked accordion of categories, brands, price, etc., with counts.

Name: Search History Chip Cloud
Description: Visual cluster of the user’s frequent queries for quick re‑selection.

Name: Hierarchical Category Tree Filter
Description: Expandable nested list letting users drill into category levels.

Name: Spell‑Correction Banner
Description: Small banner stating “Showing results for _laptop_ (searched for _lapotp_)”.

Name: Numeric Range Slider
Description: Dual‑handle slider for parameters like price, rating, distance.

Name: Date‑Range Picker Filter
Description: Two‑calendar popover selecting start/end dates, updates result set instantly.

Name: Infinite Scroll Loader
Description: Spinner at bottom that auto‑fetches the next page of results.

Name: Collapsible Facet Section
Description: Each filter group can collapse to keep the sidebar tidy on smaller screens.

Name: Global Search Bar
Description: Prominent top‑bar input with placeholder text (“Search everything…”).

Name: Result Highlight Mark
Description: Yellow background on keywords inside result snippets.

Name: Search Insight Panel
Description: Collapsible side panel summarizing top categories, brands, and price ranges in current results.

Name: Synonym Match Toggle
Description: Checkbox to include synonyms, widening or narrowing results.

Name: Sticky Filter Summary (Mobile)
Description: Small bar on mobile showing “3 Filters” and a “Sort” button while scrolling.
